strings.text: The Chrysalids

You are David Strorm, son of the strictest man in Waknuk. Here one toe too many is reason enough to cast a child out into the Fringes. You and your friends differ in a way no one can see: you speak to each other in thoughts. So far, no one knows.
strings.translation: 你是大衛·史卓姆，瓦克納克最嚴厲的那個男人的兒子。在這裡，腳上多長一根腳趾，就足以讓一個孩子被趕進邊緣地帶。你和你的朋友們也與眾不同，只是沒有人看得出來：你們用思緒彼此交談。到目前為止，還沒有人知道。

strings.text: In a community where any difference is a sin, a boy hides his gift: he hears his friends’ thoughts.
strings.translation: 在一個任何差異都是罪的村落裡，一個男孩藏著他的天賦：他聽得見朋友們的思緒。

strings.text: after the novel by John Wyndham
strings.translation: 改編自約翰·溫德姆的小說

strings.text: Six toes
How to speak to Sophie
“Does it hurt?”
“Whose are you?”
sit beside her
The rider on the meadow
covered it in time
too late
Mrs Wender’s look
a finger to my lips
look away
The find in the ruins
take it home
leave it to the Old People
Sophie’s secret
keep quiet
tell my mother
I was ten. The sandy bank by the stream was all mine.
strings.translation: 我十歲那年，小溪邊的那片沙坡全歸我一個人。

strings.text: Until a girl got up out of the grass at the top.
strings.translation: 直到坡頂的草叢裡站起來一個女孩。

strings.text: Does it hurt?
Whose are you?
Sit beside her
Does it hurt?
It hurts. Only don’t look at it.
Whose are you? I haven’t seen you before.
strings.translation: 你是誰家的？我以前沒見過你。

strings.text: The Wenders’. We live over the hill.
strings.translation: 溫德家的。我們住在山丘那一頭。

strings.text: Untie it. Only carefully.
I sat down beside her and said nothing. She cried a little more, and was quiet.
strings.translation: 我在她身邊坐下，什麼也沒說。她又哭了一會兒，就安靜下來了。

strings.text: There were six toes on her foot.
Every Sunday my father read us the Definitions: “And each foot shall have five toes.”
strings.translation: 每個星期天，父親都會唸《定義》給我們聽：「每隻腳都要有五根腳趾。」

strings.text: Hooves. Her foot must not be seen.
strings.translation: 馬蹄聲。絕不能讓人看見她的腳。

strings.text: The rider went by and did not turn his head.
strings.translation: 騎馬的人經過，連頭也沒轉。

strings.text: The rider reined in his horse. He looked at us from the meadow — a long time.
strings.translation: 騎馬的人勒住了馬。他從草地那頭望著我們——望了很久。

strings.text: Then he rode on.
Promise you won’t tell anyone.
strings.translation: 答應我，你不會告訴任何人。

strings.text: I promise
I promise.
Mummy!
Finger to lips
Look away
She nodded to me. As to a grown-up.
strings.translation: 她向我點了點頭，像對一個大人那樣。

strings.text: Mrs Wender will remember this.
strings.translation: 溫德太太會記住這件事。

strings.text: I looked at the sand. When I raised my eyes, she was already going — quickly, without looking back.
strings.translation: 我盯著沙地。等我抬起眼睛，她已經走了——走得很快，頭也不回。

strings.text: Her name was Sophie. From that day on we met nearly every day.
strings.translation: 她叫蘇菲。從那天起，我們幾乎天天見面。

strings.text: All summer we ran off to the ruins of the Old People — where we were not allowed to go.
strings.translation: 整個夏天，我們都偷偷跑去古人的廢墟——那個不准我們去的地方。

strings.text: Something glinted in the grass. I began to scrape the earth away with my hands.
strings.translation: 草叢裡有東西在閃光。我開始用手把土扒開。

strings.text: A smooth plate with the Old People’s letters on it. What had it been for?
strings.translation: 一塊光滑的板子，上面有古人的文字。他們拿它做什麼用呢？

strings.text: Showing the way
For prayers
A toy
To show the way.
They prayed to it.
It’s just a toy.
Perhaps. Only the roads from here had led nowhere for a long time.
strings.translation: 也許吧。只是從這裡出發的路，早就哪裡也通不到了。

strings.text: Hush. If they hear, we’ll be in trouble.
strings.translation: 小聲點。被聽到的話，我們就慘了。

strings.text: Some toys they had!
Take it home
Leave it
I pushed it inside my shirt.
Let it lie. The Old People knew so much — and lost it all the same.
strings.translation: 就讓它躺在這裡吧。古人知道那麼多事——結果還是全都失去了。

strings.text: From far off, from Waknuk, came the sound of the bell. Time to go home.
strings.translation: 遠遠地，從瓦克納克那邊傳來了鐘聲。該回家了。

strings.text: I never did dig it out all the way.
strings.translation: 我始終沒能把它整個挖出來。

strings.text: Grab it, run
Pull it, run
Drop it, run
Run home
At home it smelt of bread and wax.
strings.translation: 家裡有麵包和蠟的味道。

strings.text: Where have you been all day, David?
strings.translation: 大衛，你一整天跑到哪裡去了？

strings.text: By the stream
About the girl
By the stream. On my own.
I met a girl. She has six toes on her foot.
strings.translation: 我遇到一個女孩。她的腳上有六根腳趾。

strings.text: Sophie will remember this.
Your father was asking. Don’t be late for prayers.
strings.translation: 你父親在問你。禱告別遲到了。

strings.text: No one. Do you hear? Not your father, not the inspector. No one.
strings.translation: 誰都不能說。聽到了嗎？不能告訴你父親，也不能告訴檢查官。誰都不能說。

strings.text: Sophie will not know of it. Not yet.
strings.translation: 蘇菲不會知道這件事。至少現在還不會。

strings.text: That night I hid the Old People’s plate under a floorboard.
strings.translation: 那天夜裡，我把古人的板子藏在一塊地板底下。

strings.text: As it should be
The evening chores
as it should be
lost the order
The cut hand
hold my hand out to my mother
“I can do it”
“If I had another hand”
say it again to my father
“Nothing, Father”
On my knees
look for my mother
look at the floor
The calf
tell my father
lead it behind the barn
On our knees with everyone
go down on my knees
be late
The hymn by the fire
sing at the top of my voice
move my lips
keep silent
The stalk on the ashes
stay by the stalk
go with my mother
The night before the raid
warn Sophie
stay at home
With my father everything was done as it should be. In the evening — water from the well, then the barn, then prayers.
strings.translation: 父親家裡，什麼事都得合乎規矩。晚上——先去井邊打水，再去穀倉，然後禱告。

strings.text: Not now. First — water from the well.
Not now. First — the barn.
Now — prayers.
Draw water
Shut the barn
Go to prayers
My father saw it all. He said nothing — and that was the worst of it.
strings.translation: 父親全看在眼裡。他什麼也沒說——而這才是最糟的。

strings.text: That evening I cut my hand open on the harrow.
strings.translation: 那天晚上，我的手被耙子劃開了一道口子。

strings.text: When my father was reading, one came into the house on tiptoe.
strings.translation: 父親讀經的時候，進屋都得踮著腳。

strings.text: Offer my hand
I’ll do it
I can do it.
Give it here.
That’s no way to tie it.
If I’d had another hand, I could have managed it myself.
strings.translation: 要是我再多一隻手，我自己就弄得好了。

strings.text: What did you say?
Say it again
Nothing, Father
I said… if I had another hand…
strings.translation: 我說……要是我再多一隻手……

strings.text: This is the Image of God. One head. Two hands.
strings.translation: 這就是神的形象。一個頭。兩隻手。

strings.text: Lord, forgive him his word. Let him never wish for another image.
strings.translation: 主啊，饒恕他所說的話。願他永不渴求別的形象。

strings.text: Raise my eyes
Look down
I looked at the floor. Only much later did I learn that she had looked at me then.
strings.translation: 我盯著地板。很久以後我才知道，那時她看了我一眼。

strings.text: Go upstairs.
No one cleared away my bowl that evening.
strings.translation: 那天晚上，沒有人收走我的碗。

strings.text: Nothing, Father.
Emily. What did he say?
That his hand hurts, Joseph. That is all.
strings.translation: 他說手痛，約瑟。就這樣而已。

strings.text: Mother will remember this.
My mother had never lied to my father before.
strings.translation: 媽媽以前從來沒有對父親說過謊。

strings.text: Every autumn the inspector came and decided what should live.
strings.translation: 每年秋天，檢查官都會來，裁定什麼可以活下去。

strings.text: I watched our calf from behind the barn — until the inspector looked at it.
strings.translation: 我從穀倉後面看著我們的小牛——直到檢查官的目光落到牠身上。

strings.text: Tell my father
Its legs were a little too long. Only a little.
strings.translation: 牠的腿長了一點。只長了一點點。

strings.text: The inspector reached the calf before I did. Its legs were a little too long. Only a little.
strings.translation: 檢查官比我先走到小牛那裡。牠的腿長了一點。只長了一點點。

strings.text: Lead it away
Father, the calf’s legs aren’t right.
While the inspector leafed through his book, I led the calf away behind the barn.
strings.translation: 趁檢查官翻著他的冊子，我把小牛牽到了穀倉後面。

strings.text: The inspector found nothing. But the farmhand saw where I had taken it.
strings.translation: 檢查官什麼也沒找到。可是長工看見我把牠牽到哪裡去了。

strings.text: The farmhand will remember this.
I told. My father turned slowly towards me.
strings.translation: 我說了。父親慢慢轉過身來看我。

strings.text: I kept quiet. The inspector saw it for himself.
strings.translation: 我沒出聲。檢查官自己看出來了。

strings.text: You keep your eyes open. That is good, David.
strings.translation: 你眼睛很尖。這很好，大衛。

strings.text: Father will remember this.
They took the calf away. My father did not look my way.
strings.translation: 他們把小牛帶走了。父親沒有往我這邊看。

strings.text: They burned the deviant wheat till dawn, the whole community together. What was in doubt, the inspector decided.
strings.translation: 整個村落一起焚燒變異的小麥，一直燒到天亮。有疑問的，由檢查官裁定。

strings.text: An Offence.
Kneel
Everyone was on their knees already. Everyone but me.
strings.translation: 大家都已經跪下了。只有我還沒有。

strings.text: The wheat caught at once, crackling like straw.
strings.translation: 小麥一下就燒了起來，像稻草一樣劈啪作響。

strings.text: Everyone sang. You had to sing with everyone — in time.
strings.translation: 大家都在唱。你得跟著大家一起唱——合著拍子。

strings.text: David… Will they do that to us too? Into the fire?
strings.translation: 大衛……他們也會這樣對我們嗎？丟進火裡？

strings.text: Don’t sing with them. Please.
strings.translation: 不要跟他們一起唱。拜託。

strings.text: I sang loudly, louder than my mother. The voice was not mine.
strings.translation: 我唱得很大聲，比媽媽還大聲。那聲音不像是我的。

strings.text: I only moved my lips. My father was looking straight at us.
strings.translation: 我只動了動嘴唇。父親正直直地看著我們。

strings.text: I did not sing. My father was looking straight at us.
strings.translation: 我沒有唱。父親正直直地看著我們。

strings.text: By morning all that was left of the field was a grey strip.
strings.translation: 到了早上，整片田只剩下一條灰色的帶子。

strings.text: Stay by it
Go with Mother
Don’t look over there, David. Come along.
I did not look back.
When my father was reading, you were not to stir.
strings.translation: 父親讀經的時候，誰都不准動一下。

strings.text: I took hold of the edge of the table and kept still.
strings.translation: 我抓住桌子邊緣，一動也不動。

strings.text: “And each leg shall have two joints and one foot, and each foot five toes…”
strings.translation: 「每條腿都要有兩個關節和一隻腳，每隻腳都要有五根腳趾……」

strings.text: …and whatever is not so formed is a Blasphemy against the true Image, and hateful in the sight of God.
strings.translation: ……凡不是這樣造成的，都是對真正形象的褻瀆，在神眼中可憎。

strings.text: A rider saw the Wender girl by the stream. Barefoot.
strings.translation: 有個騎馬的人在小溪邊看見了溫德家的女孩。光著腳。

strings.text: The Wenders have a daughter with a Deviation. They’ll be fetched in the morning.
strings.translation: 溫德家的女兒有異常。明天早上就去抓他們。

strings.text: David? What’s wrong with you? You’re as tight as a string.
strings.translation: 大衛？你怎麼了？你整個人繃得像一根弦。

strings.text: Sit still while the Word is read.
My mother did not raise her eyes. She knew whom he meant.
strings.translation: 媽媽沒有抬起眼睛。她知道他說的是誰。

strings.text: I looked at the table and counted my heartbeats.
strings.translation: 我盯著桌子，數著自己的心跳。

strings.text: Warn the Wenders
Stay in bed
I lay down without undressing.
I waited until the house was still.
strings.translation: 我等到家裡全都靜下來。

strings.text: They’ll come for you in the morning.
strings.translation: 明天早上他們會來抓你們。

strings.text: Mummy knows. We’re going to the Fringes.
strings.translation: 媽媽知道了。我們要去邊緣地帶。

strings.text: Thank you, David.
In the morning the Wenders’ house stood empty.
strings.translation: 早上，溫德家的房子已經空了。

strings.text: I lay and listened to the rain.
Sophie will think you knew.
strings.translation: 蘇菲會以為你早就知道。

strings.text: They were caught at the very edge of the Fringes. They said Sophie broke free and ran into the forest.
strings.translation: 他們在邊緣地帶的邊上被抓住了。聽說蘇菲掙脫了，逃進了森林。

strings.text: Voices
Uncle Axel asked
point to the window
shake my head
A strange voice
answer her
Rosalind on the square
look at her
not look
Anne leaves
let her go
tell Axel
Uncle Axel had been a sailor once. Then he hurt his leg and became my father’s smith.
strings.translation: 艾克索姑丈以前當過水手。後來他的腿受了傷，就成了父親家的鐵匠。

strings.text: I liked to sit on a barrel in his forge. And to chatter — with someone no one but me could hear.
strings.translation: 我喜歡坐在他鐵匠鋪裡的木桶上。還喜歡聊天——跟一個除了我以外誰也聽不見的人。

strings.text: David? Are you at the forge again?
Yes. Uncle’s making horseshoes. It’s warm here.
strings.translation: 嗯。姑丈在打馬蹄鐵。這裡好暖和。

strings.text: Our cow got loose. The whole house was out catching her.
strings.translation: 我們家的牛掙脫了。全家人都跑出去抓牠。

strings.text: I laughed out loud. My uncle’s hammer stopped.
strings.translation: 我笑出了聲。姑丈的鐵鎚停住了。

strings.text: Who are you talking to, Davie?
Show the window
Shake my head
Beyond the field the Mortons’ window was lit. That was where Rosalind lived.
strings.translation: 田野那頭，莫頓家的窗子亮著燈。羅莎琳就住在那裡。

strings.text: Right across the field? Without words?
No one, eh? And yet you look — over there.
strings.translation: 沒有人，是吧？可是你一直往那邊看。

strings.text: No one, do you hear? Not your father, not your mother. Not a living soul.
strings.translation: 誰都不能說，聽到了嗎？不能告訴你父親，也不能告訴你母親。一個活人都不能說。

strings.text: And tell the others the same.
Your father. To the bellows, Davie. Quick.
strings.translation: 你父親來了。去拉風箱，小衛。快。

strings.text: The farmhand had told him about the calf. My father was looking not at my uncle — at me.
strings.translation: 長工把小牛的事告訴了他。父親看的不是姑丈——是我。

strings.text: My bellows wheezed out of time. My father raised his lantern and looked at me for a long while.
strings.translation: 我的風箱拉得亂了拍子，呼哧呼哧的。父親舉起提燈，看了我很久。

strings.text: My father stood a while, nodded to my uncle and went away.
strings.translation: 父親站了一會兒，向姑丈點點頭，就走了。

strings.text: My uncle said nothing. He only nodded to me across the forge.
strings.translation: 姑丈什麼也沒說。只是隔著鐵匠鋪向我點了點頭。

strings.text: In the evenings my uncle told me what he had seen over the sea.
strings.translation: 晚上，姑丈會跟我講他在海的那一邊看到的事。

strings.text: The sea?
The Old People?
The people there?
What is it like, the sea?
Have you seen where the Old People lived?
strings.translation: 你看過古人住過的地方嗎？

strings.text: And what are the people like there?
strings.translation: 那裡的人是什麼樣子的？

strings.text: Bigger than all our land. You sail for weeks — and not a shore in sight.
strings.translation: 比我們所有的土地還大。你可以航行好幾個星期——連一片海岸都看不見。

strings.text: I have. Black glass for miles and miles. Nothing grows there to this day.
strings.translation: 看過。好幾哩好幾哩的黑色玻璃。那裡到今天都還寸草不生。

strings.text: All sorts. In the south there’s a coast where everyone has six toes. And they think we’re the deviants.
strings.translation: 什麼樣的都有。南邊有一片海岸，那裡每個人都有六根腳趾。他們還認為我們才是異變的。

strings.text: Our ship was a tall one, three masts. Sails one above the other.
strings.translation: 我們的船很高，有三根桅杆。帆一面疊著一面。

strings.text: And over the glass — towers. Taller than our church tower, and every one of them broken.
strings.translation: 玻璃上方立著高塔。比我們的教堂鐘樓還高，而且每一座都是斷的。

strings.text: Their coast is green. The trees are thin and tall, and their tops are like umbrellas.
strings.translation: 他們的海岸是綠色的。樹又細又高，樹頂像一把把傘。

strings.text: I showed him the plate from the ruins.
strings.translation: 我把廢墟裡的那塊板子拿給他看。

strings.text: Hide it. And don’t show it to your father.
strings.translation: 藏好。也別拿給你父親看。

strings.text: I thought of Sophie.
The true image, you say? And who has ever seen it, this image?
strings.translation: 真正的形象，你說？那誰見過這個形象？

strings.text: Labrador isn’t the whole world, Davie.
strings.translation: 拉布拉多可不是整個世界，小衛。

strings.text: The years went by. We found one another — those who could hear.
strings.translation: 一年年過去。我們找到了彼此——那些聽得見的人。

strings.text: By day, at work, we learnt to know one another right across the valley.
strings.translation: 白天幹活的時候，我們學著隔著整座山谷認出彼此。

strings.text: Half the day at the washing line again. Is anybody there?
strings.translation: 又在曬衣繩旁邊耗了半天。有人在嗎？

strings.text: Anne.
Anne. She found me herself.
The sheep are scattered all over the hill. David, where are you?
strings.translation: 羊群散得滿山都是。大衛，你在哪裡？

strings.text: The ploughman looked at me a long time from under his hand. And I stood and looked at the sky.
strings.translation: 犁田的人用手遮著眼睛，看了我很久。而我只是站著，望著天空。

strings.text: I went back to my hoeing. The ploughman stood a while and started his horse.
strings.translation: 我又回頭鋤我的地。犁田的人站了一會兒，才吆喝馬兒繼續走。

strings.text: Michael. Then Mark answered — from a cart on the road.
strings.translation: 麥可。接著是馬克回應了——從路上的一輛馬車上。

strings.text: Who’s there? Who is it talking?
Don’t answer. We don’t know her.
She’s all alone out there. As we were once.
strings.translation: 她一個人孤零零的在那裡。就像我們從前一樣。

strings.text: Answer her
Keep quiet
I thought I was the only one.
Now there are nine of us. And nine of us who might let it slip.
strings.translation: 現在我們有九個人了。也就有九個可能說溜嘴的人。

strings.text: Who’s there…?
She called for a few more evenings. Then she stopped.
strings.translation: 她又呼喚了幾個晚上。後來就不再呼喚了。

strings.text: We were sixteen. In front of everyone, Rosalind and I were almost strangers.
strings.translation: 我們十六歲了。在眾人面前，我和羅莎琳幾乎形同陌路。

strings.text: That day the old woman by the well never took her eyes off me.
strings.translation: 那天，井邊的老婦人一直盯著我不放。

strings.text: My eyes went looking for her by themselves. I kept taking them away — to the well, to the church, anywhere.
strings.translation: 我的眼睛總是不由自主地去找她。我一次次把視線移開——移到井上，移到教堂上，移到哪裡都好。

strings.text: Don’t look at me. Just listen.
Some day we’ll go away from here. The two of us.
strings.translation: 總有一天，我們會離開這裡。我們兩個人。

strings.text: Where to? It’s the Fringes all round.
strings.translation: 去哪裡？四周都是邊緣地帶。

strings.text: Uncle says the world is bigger than Labrador.
strings.translation: 姑丈說，世界比拉布拉多還大。

strings.text: Then — there.
I’m smiling now. A pity you can’t see.
strings.translation: 我現在在笑喔。可惜你看不到。

strings.text: Don’t. They’re looking at us.
The old woman with the stick watched us until we parted.
strings.translation: 那個拄著拐杖的老婦人一直盯著我們，直到我們分開。

strings.text: Rosalind will remember this.
I never did turn round. She went off with her parents without looking back.
strings.translation: 我始終沒有轉身。她跟著父母走了，頭也沒回。

strings.text: Some day I want you to look at me. In front of everyone.
strings.translation: 總有一天，我希望你看著我。在所有人面前。

strings.text: At night I went up the hill and called them. One after another.
strings.translation: 夜裡，我爬上山丘呼喚他們。一個接一個。

strings.text: I’m here.
Here. Why so late?
And me.
Suddenly an answer came from our own house — so thin and so loud my ears rang. And at once it was gone.
strings.translation: 忽然，我們自己家裡有人回應了——那聲音又細又響，震得我耳朵嗡嗡作響。然後一下子就消失了。

strings.text: Then Sally and Katherine. Mark. Rachel.
strings.translation: 接著是莎莉和凱瑟琳。馬克。瑞秋。

strings.text: Don’t call me any more. I’m marrying Alan Ervin.
strings.translation: 別再呼喚我了。我要嫁給艾倫·厄文了。

strings.text: I want to live like everyone else. Do you hear? Like everyone else.
strings.translation: 我想跟大家一樣過日子。聽到了嗎？跟大家一樣。

strings.text: She’ll tell him. Not at once — but in a year.
strings.translation: 她會告訴他的。不會馬上說——但一年之內一定會。

strings.text: She’s one of us. You can’t hold her by force.
strings.translation: 她是我們的一份子。你不能硬把她留下來。

strings.text: Let her go
Tell Axel
Then we’ll pray she keeps quiet.
strings.translation: 那我們就祈禱她保持沉默吧。

strings.text: Anne will remember this.
I told my uncle about Anne and Alan.
strings.translation: 我把安和艾倫的事告訴了姑丈。

strings.text: All right. Off to bed, Davie.
A week later Alan was found by the road. With an arrow in his throat.
strings.translation: 一個星期後，有人在路邊發現了艾倫。喉嚨上插著一支箭。

strings.text: My uncle asked me nothing. Nor I him.
strings.translation: 姑丈什麼也沒問我。我也什麼都沒問他。

strings.text: It was you. I know it was you.
Anne answered no more.
And at home, in the little room, my sister Petra was asleep.
strings.translation: 而在家裡的小房間裡，我的妹妹佩特拉正睡著。

strings.text: I did not know yet who had answered me from our house.
strings.translation: 那時我還不知道，從我們家回應我的是誰。

strings.text: Petra
The cry at the river
she went quiet
she cried to the end
Petra’s gift
teach her to hide her thoughts
let her be herself
The voice from over the sea
answer
only listen
In spring, when Petra was six, she went off to the river alone.
strings.translation: 那年春天，佩特拉六歲，她一個人跑到了河邊。

strings.text: And then it struck into my head. Not a voice — fear, enormous, without words.
strings.translation: 接著，有個東西猛地撞進我的腦袋。不是聲音——是恐懼，巨大的、沒有言語的恐懼。

strings.text: David…!
Petra, I’m here. Breathe with me.
strings.translation: 佩特拉，我在這裡。跟著我呼吸。

strings.text: She went quiet. No one farther than Rosalind heard her.
strings.translation: 她安靜下來了。除了羅莎琳，再遠一點的人都沒聽見她。

strings.text: The grown-ups heard not a sound. They saw her run.
strings.translation: 大人們一點聲音都沒聽到。他們只看見她在跑。

strings.text: I brought her out onto the bank. She was crying — out loud, like any child.
strings.translation: 我把她帶上了岸。她在哭——哭出聲音來，就像任何一個孩子一樣。

strings.text: I brought her out onto the bank. She called to the very last — and not with her mouth.
strings.translation: 我把她帶上了岸。她一直呼喚到最後一刻——而且不是用嘴巴。

strings.text: Is that her? Your sister?
I held on. But the branch broke.
strings.translation: 我有抓緊。可是樹枝斷掉了。

strings.text: All of ours heard her. And they saw us running.
strings.translation: 我們所有人都聽見她了。而他們看見我們在跑。

strings.text: She went quiet all of a sudden. Was it you who calmed her?
strings.translation: 她突然安靜下來了。是你讓她平靜下來的嗎？

strings.text: She’s stronger than all of us, David. What are we going to do with her?
strings.translation: 她比我們所有人都強，大衛。我們該拿她怎麼辦？

strings.text: Carry Petra home
From that day Petra was among us. Her thoughts thundered all over the district.
strings.translation: 從那天起，佩特拉就成了我們的一份子。她的思緒響徹了整個地區。

strings.text: Here. Quietly, David. She’s listening.
strings.translation: 在這裡。小聲點，大衛。她在聽。

strings.text: David, is that you? I want to be with you too!
strings.translation: 大衛，是你嗎？我也想跟你們在一起！

strings.text: She shouted us all down. Alone.
strings.translation: 她一個人就把我們全部蓋過去了。

strings.text: Anne has guessed already. Teach Petra to hide her thoughts, David.
strings.translation: 安已經猜到了。教佩特拉藏起她的思緒吧，大衛。

strings.text: Teach her to hide her thoughts. Or the wrong people will hear her.
strings.translation: 教她藏起思緒。不然會被不該聽見的人聽見。

strings.text: We hide all our lives. Let her at least be as she is.
strings.translation: 我們一輩子都在躲藏。至少讓她做原本的自己吧。

strings.text: Hide her thoughts
Let her call
My father taught me to spot Deviations. Now I was teaching my sister to hide them.
strings.translation: 父親教我找出異常。現在我卻在教妹妹把它藏起來。

strings.text: Every evening I taught her: think quietly, very quietly, as if you were whispering.
strings.translation: 每天晚上我都教她：想的時候要小聲，很小很小聲，就像在說悄悄話一樣。

strings.text: All right. I’ll be tiny, tiny.
strings.translation: 好。我會變得小小的、小小的。

strings.text: Petra will remember this.
David! I can hear all of you! All of you!
strings.translation: 大衛！我聽得到你們所有人！所有人喔！

strings.text: She’ll give us away, David.
strings.translation: 她會害我們暴露的，大衛。

strings.text: Once already I had told myself to keep quiet. I did not want to again.
strings.translation: 我曾經叫自己保持沉默過一次。我不想再那樣了。

strings.text: I dreamt of that city again. I followed a shining fish with my eyes — quietly, quietly, so as not to wake.
strings.translation: 我又夢見了那座城市。我用目光追著一條發亮的魚——輕輕地、輕輕地，免得醒過來。

strings.text: The dream fell apart. I never made out the towers.
strings.translation: 夢碎了。我始終沒看清那些高塔。

strings.text: I had time to make out every tower.
strings.translation: 我來得及看清每一座高塔。

strings.text: A month later Petra woke me in the middle of the night.
strings.translation: 一個月後，佩特拉在半夜把我叫醒。

strings.text: David, somebody’s talking out there. Far, far away, over the water.
strings.translation: 大衛，那邊有人在說話。很遠很遠，在水的那一邊。

strings.text: She showed me what she saw. And I knew the city from my dream.
strings.translation: 她把她看到的東西給我看。我認出了夢裡的那座城市。

strings.text: Who are you, little girl? Where are you? You call so loudly.
strings.translation: 你是誰，小女孩？你在哪裡？你的呼喚好響亮。

strings.text: …who are you… where…
I can’t hear words. Only that somebody’s there.
strings.translation: 我聽不到話。只知道那邊有人。

strings.text: Answer her, Petra
Don’t answer
Answer her, Petra.
Don’t answer. We don’t know who it is.
strings.translation: 別回答。我們不知道那是誰。

strings.text: I’m Petra! I’m here!
I hear you. Call to me again.
David, what is it? Someone strange can hear us.
strings.translation: 大衛，那是什麼？有陌生人聽得到我們。

strings.text: Petra did as she was told. The voice called a while longer, fainter and fainter, and then it was gone.
strings.translation: 佩特拉照我說的做了。那個聲音又呼喚了一陣子，越來越微弱，然後就消失了。

strings.text: That city was real. Somewhere over the sea.
strings.translation: 那座城市是真的。就在海的某一邊。

strings.text: I never did know whether it was a dream.
strings.translation: 我始終不知道那是不是一場夢。

strings.text: Discovery
When Katherine and Sally were taken
strings.translation: 凱瑟琳和莎莉被抓走的時候

strings.text: run now
get them out
The man with the lantern
keep the bellows’ rhythm
give my uncle the nod
got away
caught
Questioning
deny it
tell the truth
The trial
my own got me out
blew out the lamp
knocked over the lamp
Sheba
let her go home
take her along
The rider on the crest
shoot him
over his head
freeze in the fog
By the shadows
went in the shadows
the lantern saw us
That evening my father read longer than usual.
strings.translation: 那天晚上，父親讀經讀得比平常久。

strings.text: Anne is dead. She left a letter for the inspector. All our names are in it.
strings.translation: 安死了。她留了一封信給檢查官。我們所有人的名字都在裡面。

strings.text: Anne told Alan everything. In the morning Alan was at the inspector’s.
strings.translation: 安把一切都告訴了艾倫。早上艾倫就去了檢查官那裡。

strings.text: We’ve been given away.
They’ve taken Katherine and Sally. They’re being questioned.
strings.translation: 他們抓走了凱瑟琳和莎莉。她們正在被審問。

strings.text: David… They’re asking about you. I won’t tell. I’ll try.
strings.translation: 大衛……他們在問你的事。我不會說的。我會努力。

strings.text: David. What are you thinking about while I read?
strings.translation: 大衛。我讀經的時候，你在想什麼？

strings.text: He’s tired, Joseph. Let him go to bed.
strings.translation: 他累了，約瑟。讓他去睡吧。

strings.text: Go tonight. With Petra. Rosalind will wait at the ford.
strings.translation: 今晚就走。帶著佩特拉。羅莎琳會在淺灘等你。

strings.text: Go with Petra
Free the girls
Then I’ll wait at the ford. Till dawn — no longer.
strings.translation: 那我就在淺灘等。等到天亮——不會再久了。

strings.text: Katherine and Sally will remember this.
strings.translation: 凱瑟琳和莎莉會記住這件事。

strings.text: In the night I woke Petra and carried her out of the house.
strings.translation: 夜裡，我叫醒佩特拉，把她抱出了屋子。

strings.text: David, where are we going?
Far away. Only think quietly.
strings.translation: 很遠的地方。只是想的時候要小聲。

strings.text: I can’t do quietly!
Look back
Don’t look back
My mother stood at the window. She watched us go, and she did not call my father.
strings.translation: 媽媽站在窗邊。她看著我們離開，沒有叫醒父親。

strings.text: The window went dark. No one in the house woke.
strings.translation: 窗子暗了。屋裡沒有人醒來。

strings.text: Riders were waiting at the gate. The inspector knew whom to come for.
strings.translation: 騎馬的人在大門口等著。檢查官知道該來找誰。

strings.text: Petra, run to the ford. To Rosalind.
strings.translation: 佩特拉，跑去淺灘。去找羅莎琳。

strings.text: Petra slipped out of my arms and vanished into the dark. No one went after her.
strings.translation: 佩特拉從我懷裡溜下去，消失在黑暗中。沒有人去追她。

strings.text: I hear her. I’m coming to meet her.
I ran to Uncle Axel. There was no one else to go to.
strings.translation: 我跑去找艾克索姑丈。我沒有別人可以投靠了。

strings.text: They’re holding them at the inspector’s, in the cellar. The door’s locked.
strings.translation: 他們被關在檢查官家的地窖裡。門上了鎖。

strings.text: I’ll make a key. And you work the bellows — let them think I’m working.
strings.translation: 鑰匙我來打。你去拉風箱——讓他們以為我在幹活。

strings.text: A man with a lantern stopped in the gateway.
strings.translation: 一個提著燈的人在門口停了下來。

strings.text: My father’s farmhand. The one who saw the calf.
strings.translation: 是父親的長工。看見小牛的那個人。

strings.text: Work the bellows
Nod to strike
He looked me in the face — and whistled. Two more came up out of the dark.
strings.translation: 他看著我的臉——吹了一聲口哨。黑暗中又走來了兩個人。

strings.text: My uncle stood there with his hammer. I shook my head: don’t.
strings.translation: 姑丈拿著鐵鎚站在那裡。我搖搖頭：不要。

strings.text: He stood a while and went away. He did not notice. Or did not want to.
strings.translation: 他站了一會兒就走了。他沒注意到。或者是不想注意到。

strings.text: My uncle stepped towards the gate. The man had no time to turn round.
strings.translation: 姑丈朝門口跨了一步。那人來不及轉身。

strings.text: We dragged him into the dark. He was breathing.
strings.translation: 我們把他拖進暗處。他還有呼吸。

strings.text: Towards morning my uncle came back alone.
strings.translation: 天快亮的時候，姑丈一個人回來了。

strings.text: They’re away. Another road, to the Fringes. Now it’s your turn, Davie.
strings.translation: 她們走了。走另一條路，往邊緣地帶去了。現在輪到你了，小衛。

strings.text: They brought me to the meeting-house. It was night; one lamp burned on the elders’ table.
strings.translation: 他們把我帶到聚會所。那時是夜裡，長老的桌上點著一盞燈。

strings.text: The men came in one by one and sat down along the walls. My father stood apart.
strings.translation: 男人們一個一個走進來，沿著牆坐下。父親獨自站在一旁。

strings.text: The girls named you, David. Do you hear them without words?
strings.translation: 女孩們說出了你的名字，大衛。你不用說話就聽得見她們嗎？

strings.text: I don’t understand
Keep silent
I hear them
I don’t understand what you mean.
I do. And there is no sin in it.
strings.translation: 我聽得見。而且這沒有罪。

strings.text: They didn’t understand at first either.
Answer when you are asked.
Then you are no son of mine.
In the morning they’ll take you away. They’ll ask you differently there.
strings.translation: 明天早上他們會把你帶走。到了那裡，他們會用別的方法問你。

strings.text: David. We’re close. Now.
strings.translation: 大衛。我們就在附近。就是現在。

strings.text: Someone shouted in the yard: the barn was on fire.
strings.translation: 院子裡有人大喊：穀倉著火了。

strings.text: Everyone rushed for the doors — the inspector, my father, the men.
strings.translation: 大家都衝向門口——檢查官、父親、男人們。

strings.text: Petra’s with us — we got her out through the window. Run to the ford.
strings.translation: 佩特拉跟我們在一起——我們從窗戶把她帶出來了。快跑去淺灘。

strings.text: Petra’s with me. Run to the ford.
strings.translation: 佩特拉在我這裡。快跑去淺灘。

strings.text: Run
There are too few of us, David. Get yourself out.
strings.translation: 我們人太少了，大衛。你得自己逃出來。

strings.text: Blow it out
Knock it over
In the dark my father caught me by the sleeve. I tore free.
strings.translation: 黑暗中，父親抓住了我的袖子。我掙脫了。

strings.text: He shouted after me until I reached the gate.
strings.translation: 他在後面一直對我大吼，直到我跑到大門口。

strings.text: The oil flared up across the floor. Everyone rushed to put it out, and I made for the window.
strings.translation: 燈油在地板上燒了起來。大家都衝去滅火，而我往窗戶跑去。

strings.text: I carried Petra out through the window of her room.
strings.translation: 我從佩特拉房間的窗戶把她抱了出來。

strings.text: I took Sheba from the paddock behind the house. Petra was already waiting for me — in a pannier on Rosalind’s horse.
strings.translation: 我從屋後的圍欄裡牽出席巴。佩特拉已經在等我了——坐在羅莎琳馬背上的馱籃裡。

strings.text: David! I knew you’d come!
Rosalind was waiting beyond the ford, on the ridge, with her father’s two great-horses.
strings.translation: 羅莎琳在淺灘另一邊的山脊上等著，帶著她父親的兩匹巨馬。

strings.text: I’m staying. I’ll be among them — and I’ll listen.
strings.translation: 我留下來。我會待在他們中間——然後仔細聽著。

strings.text: Let her go, David. She’s no match for the great-horses. And she neighs fit to wake the whole district.
strings.translation: 讓牠走吧，大衛。牠跟不上巨馬的。而且牠一叫，整個地區都會被吵醒。

strings.text: Let Sheba go
Take Sheba
Sheba went home alone. There was no way back.
strings.translation: 席巴獨自回家了。我們已經沒有回頭路了。

strings.text: I couldn’t. I led her back and tied her rein to the pack-horse.
strings.translation: 我做不到。我把牠牽回來，把韁繩綁在馱馬上。

strings.text: Lanterns on the road. Your father is with them.
strings.translation: 路上有提燈。你父親跟他們在一起。

strings.text: They found that man at the forge. The whole district has turned out after you.
strings.translation: 他們發現了鐵匠鋪那個人。整個地區的人都出來追你們了。

strings.text: Beyond the shoulder of the ridge the road dipped into a hollow. The hollow was full of fog.
strings.translation: 繞過山脊的肩部，路往下沉進一片窪地。窪地裡滿是霧。

strings.text: We stand still. Let them go by.
Two riders with lanterns came up onto the crest.
strings.translation: 兩個提著燈的騎馬人上了山脊。

strings.text: The first one raised his lantern higher — and saw us. The second galloped back for the others.
strings.translation: 前面那個把提燈舉高——看見了我們。另一個策馬回去找其他人。

strings.text: He’s coming this way.
They shone their lanterns into the fog for a long time. Then the second turned back for the others, and the first stayed to watch the road.
strings.translation: 他們拿燈往霧裡照了很久。後來，另一個掉頭回去找其他人，前面那個留下來看守道路。

strings.text: It’ll be dawn soon. The fog will lift — and he’ll see us.
strings.translation: 天快亮了。霧一散——他就會看見我們。

strings.text: Shoot him
Over his head
Freeze
Shoot him.
Shoot over his head!
I had no time to say anything. Rosalind had already drawn her bow.
strings.translation: 我還來不及開口。羅莎琳已經拉開了弓。

strings.text: The rider fell. His horse went off over the crest alone.
strings.translation: 騎馬的人摔了下來。他的馬獨自越過了山脊。

strings.text: He wouldn’t have spared us, David.
strings.translation: 他不會放過我們的，大衛。

strings.text: He never saw us at all.
The arrow whistled just over his head. The horse shied, and the rider galloped off over the crest.
strings.translation: 箭從他頭頂上方呼嘯而過。馬受了驚，騎馬的人越過山脊逃走了。

strings.text: He saw where we went.
strings.translation: 他看見我們往哪裡去了。

strings.text: Now he knows where we are.
strings.translation: 現在他知道我們在哪裡了。

strings.text: We froze. Petra clapped her little hand over her mouth.
strings.translation: 我們一動也不動。佩特拉用小手摀住了嘴。

strings.text: He rode right up to the edge of the hollow and shone his lantern into the fog for a long time.
strings.translation: 他一直騎到窪地邊上，拿燈往霧裡照了很久。

strings.text: He rode along the edge of the hollow, shining his lantern into the fog. Very close.
strings.translation: 他沿著窪地邊緣騎，拿燈往霧裡照。離得好近。

strings.text: He saw us. He won’t come back alone.
strings.translation: 他看見我們了。他不會一個人回來的。

strings.text: We’ve lost an hour. Now they’ll reach the Fringes before us.
strings.translation: 我們耽誤了一個小時。現在他們會比我們先到邊緣地帶。

strings.text: By dawn the lanterns had fallen behind. By day we hid in the woods.
strings.translation: 天亮時，提燈被甩在了後頭。白天，我們躲在樹林裡。

strings.text: They’ve taken Katherine and Sally away. I could do nothing.
strings.translation: 他們把凱瑟琳和莎莉帶走了。我什麼也做不了。

strings.text: That rider died. There’ll be no mercy now — not for you, not for them.
strings.translation: 那個騎馬的人死了。現在不會有任何寬恕了——對你們、對她們都不會。

strings.text: We hear you. Hold on. We are coming.
strings.translation: 我們聽見你們了。撐住。我們就要來了。

strings.text: David, that lady over the water is calling again. She’s looking for us.
strings.translation: 大衛，水那邊的那位阿姨又在呼喚了。她在找我們。

strings.text: On the second night we came out to the last field. Beyond the fence the Fringes began.
strings.translation: 第二天夜裡，我們走到了最後一片田地。籬笆那一頭就是邊緣地帶。

strings.text: The lantern was carried by a tall man. I knew my father by his walk.
strings.translation: 提燈的是一個高個子的男人。我從走路的樣子認出了父親。

strings.text: The moon stood behind the woods, and the shadows of the trees lay across the field. We could walk along them — or while he shone his light the other way.
strings.translation: 月亮在樹林後面，樹影橫躺在田野上。我們可以沿著樹影走——或是趁他把燈照向別處的時候走。

strings.text: There they are! By the fence!
strings.translation: 他們在那裡！在籬笆旁邊！

strings.text: There they are! In the field!
Behind us there was shouting, lanterns running to the fence. But no one stepped over it.
strings.translation: 後面有人在喊，一盞盞提燈奔向籬笆。可是沒有人跨過去。

strings.text: The lantern stood a while by the fence and turned back.
strings.translation: 那盞提燈在籬笆邊停了一會兒，就轉身回去了。

strings.text: That’s it, David. We’re in the Fringes.
strings.translation: 就這樣了，大衛。我們到邊緣地帶了。

strings.text: The deviant forest closed behind us.
strings.translation: 異變的森林在我們身後合攏。

We were brought to the fire. The people round it were not like us. And not like the people in Waknuk.
strings.translation: 我們被帶到火堆旁。圍著火的人跟我們不一樣。也跟瓦克納克的人不一樣。

strings.text: They knew already that we had been followed right to the fence.
strings.translation: 他們已經知道，有人一路追我們追到了籬笆邊。

strings.text: By the farthest hut stood a girl in a faded headscarf. Barefoot.
strings.translation: 最遠的那間小屋旁，站著一個包著褪色頭巾的女孩。光著腳。

strings.text: Do you know her?
Go to Sophie
Wait here
I went up to her. She did not step back.
I stayed by the fire. She watched me across the whole camp.
strings.translation: 我留在火堆旁。她隔著整個營地望著我。

strings.text: David. I remember you.
You came running that night. We got away in time.
strings.translation: 那天晚上你跑來通知我們。我們及時逃出來了。

strings.text: Come into my hut. Before he’s back.
strings.translation: 到我的小屋裡來。趁他還沒回來。

strings.text: Sophie hid you.
Until evening she let no one near us.
strings.translation: 直到傍晚，她都不讓任何人靠近我們。

strings.text: That’s Strorm’s son. Joseph Strorm’s.
strings.translation: 那是史卓姆的兒子。約瑟·史卓姆的兒子。

strings.text: Sophie did not forget.
Rosalind and Petra were tied to a post. I was taken to the one who decided things here.
strings.translation: 羅莎琳和佩特拉被綁在一根柱子上。我被帶去見這裡做主的人。

strings.text: David, the rope’s prickly!
In the evening a tall man came out to the fire, with long arms like a spider’s.
strings.translation: 傍晚，一個高大的男人走到火邊，他的手臂又長又細，像蜘蛛一樣。

strings.text: He looked me over for a long time. Then he said he was my father’s brother.
strings.translation: 他打量了我很久。然後他說，他是我父親的哥哥。

strings.text: We’re here, David, Katherine and I. They leave us alone while they need us.
strings.translation: 我們在這裡，大衛，凱瑟琳和我。只要他們還用得著我們，就不會動我們。

strings.text: Your father is leading them here. You hear each other without words — you’ll be my eyes.
strings.translation: 你父親正帶著他們往這裡來。你們不用說話就聽得見彼此——你們就當我的眼睛吧。

strings.text: Stand with us — and I’ll let your people go.
strings.translation: 站到我們這邊——我就放了你的人。

strings.text: He’s just like your father, David. Only from the other side.
strings.translation: 他跟你父親一模一樣，大衛。只是站在另一邊而已。

strings.text: Stand with them
Untie my own
To the cave
He nodded, and the ropes at the post were cut.
strings.translation: 他點了點頭，柱子上的繩子就被割斷了。

strings.text: They put us by the cave above the clearing. From there you could see where they would come from.
strings.translation: 他們把我們安排在空地上方的山洞旁。從那裡看得見他們會從哪裡過來。

strings.text: In the night the fire burned low. I crawled to the post and cut the ropes.
strings.translation: 夜裡，火堆燒得只剩餘燼。我爬到柱子旁，割斷了繩子。

strings.text: Sophie saw. She turned away to the fire.
strings.translation: 蘇菲看見了。她轉過身去面向火堆。

strings.text: In the night Sophie led us out of the camp by a path even the sentries did not know.
strings.translation: 夜裡，蘇菲帶我們走一條連哨兵都不知道的小路，離開了營地。

strings.text: There was nowhere further to run. We hid in the cave above the clearing.
strings.translation: 已經無處可逃了。我們躲進了空地上方的山洞。

strings.text: At dawn a horn sounded.
They were coming on our tracks — from that same fence.
strings.translation: 他們循著我們的足跡追來——從那道籬笆追來。

strings.text: They were coming through the forest. Many of them. With guns.
strings.translation: 他們穿過森林而來。人很多。帶著槍。

strings.text: Your father is in front. I can hear him — not in words, I just know.
strings.translation: 你父親走在最前面。我聽得見他——不是用言語，我就是知道。

strings.text: David! She’s very close! She says — keep together!
strings.translation: 大衛！她離得好近！她說——大家要待在一起！

strings.text: We are almost over you. Don’t scatter. A little longer.
strings.translation: 我們幾乎就在你們頭頂了。不要散開。再撐一下。

strings.text: I call her and call her… She hears, but she can’t find us.
strings.translation: 我一直呼喚她、呼喚她……她聽得見，可是找不到我們。

strings.text: Petra was silent. No one called her from over the sea.
strings.translation: 佩特拉沒有出聲。海的那一邊沒有人呼喚她。

strings.text: Sophie ran to where the Spider-man had gone.
strings.translation: 蘇菲朝蜘蛛人離開的方向跑去。

strings.text: Sealand
The return
Stayed with Michael

The city of my dream turned out to be real. No one there counted toes.
strings.translation: 夢裡的那座城市原來是真的。那裡沒有人數腳趾。

strings.text: But even there they spoke of people of the old kind the way my father spoke of Deviations.
strings.translation: 可是即使在那裡，人們談起舊式的人，也像我父親談起異常那樣。

strings.text: Eight years later I came back to Waknuk. Unarmed.
strings.translation: 八年後，我回到了瓦克納克。沒有帶武器。

strings.text: Michael was waiting at the ford. They listened to us. Not all of them — but they listened.
strings.translation: 麥可在淺灘等著。他們聽我們說話了。不是每個人——但他們聽了。

strings.text: The ship went away. We stayed on the ledge — Rosalind, Michael and I.
strings.translation: 飛船離開了。我們留在岩架上——羅莎琳、麥可和我。

strings.text: What came next was for us to decide now.
strings.translation: 接下來會怎樣，現在由我們自己決定。

strings.text: Rosalind flew away with Petra. I stayed with Michael.
strings.translation: 羅莎琳帶著佩特拉飛走了。我和麥可一起留下。

strings.text: At night I listened to the sky. Sometimes it answered.
strings.translation: 夜裡，我聆聽著天空。有時候，它會回應。

strings.text: The ship never came. We stayed by the Fringes.
strings.translation: 飛船始終沒有來。我們留在邊緣地帶附近。

strings.text: A year later Petra stopped calling. And I stopped waiting.
strings.translation: 一年後，佩特拉不再呼喚了。我也不再等待了。

We lay behind a rock by the cave. Down below, on the clearing, there was shooting.
strings.translation: 我們趴在山洞旁的一塊岩石後面。底下的空地上，有人在開槍。

strings.text: We told the Spider-man where they were coming from. Too late to be sorry now.
strings.translation: 我們告訴了蜘蛛人他們會從哪裡來。現在後悔已經太遲了。

strings.text: Your father. In front, by the horse.
strings.translation: 你父親。在前面，馬的旁邊。

strings.text: Run to Father
Stay
You can’t, David! You can’t help him!
Sophie was running to the Spider-man.
David! Stop!
Don’t touch me.
Go, David. Get away from here.
We waited for the ship. The sky stayed empty.
strings.translation: 我們等著飛船。天空依然空蕩蕩的。

strings.text: The Waknuk men faltered and ran for the forest. They left my father behind.
strings.translation: 瓦克納克的人動搖了，紛紛逃向森林。他們把我父親丟下了。

strings.text: David… She doesn’t answer any more.
It’s her! David, it’s her!
Shield my father

Petra lay very still under me. The threads settled on my back.
strings.translation: 佩特拉在我身下靜靜地躺著。絲線落在我的背上。

strings.text: Rosalind held Petra. I held them both.
strings.translation: 羅莎琳抱著佩特拉。我抱著她們兩個。

strings.text: I reached no one in time. The threads settled on everyone.
strings.translation: 我誰都來不及護住。絲線落在了每個人身上。

strings.text: I lay over my father. The threads settled on me, not on him.
strings.translation: 我趴在父親身上。絲線落在我身上，沒有落在他身上。

strings.text: I fell beside him. The threads settled on us both.
strings.translation: 我倒在他身旁。絲線落在我們兩個身上。

strings.text: They were soft and sticky. And the more you struggled, the tighter they held.
strings.translation: 那些絲線又軟又黏。越是掙扎，就纏得越緊。

strings.text: It grew quiet. The ship came down in the middle of the clearing.
strings.translation: 四下安靜了。飛船降落在空地中央。

strings.text: It’s you! I know you!
So this is what you are like, Petra. How loudly you call.
strings.translation: 原來你就是這個樣子啊，佩特拉。你的呼喚多麼響亮。

strings.text: David! Are you alive? I can hardly hear you.
strings.translation: 大衛！你還活著嗎？我幾乎聽不到你了。

strings.text: Brave. And foolish.
Under the threads my father was breathing. I saw his fingers stir.
strings.translation: 在絲線底下，父親還在呼吸。我看見他的手指動了一下。

strings.text: This one I will not free. He came to kill you.
strings.translation: 這個人我不會放開。他是來殺你們的。

strings.text: Don’t pity them. Their time is over.
strings.translation: 別可憐他們。他們的時代已經過去了。

strings.text: I’m staying, David. Someone has to tell our kind that we exist.
strings.translation: 我留下來，大衛。總得有人告訴我們的同類，我們是存在的。

strings.text: Fly away
Stay with Michael
David, where are you going? Are you coming with us?
strings.translation: 大衛，你要去哪裡？你要跟我們一起走嗎？

strings.text: Where you go — I go.
I can’t stay, David. Not here. Not after all this.
strings.translation: 我不能留下來，大衛。不能留在這裡。經歷過這一切之後，不能。

strings.text: Come, David.
On the threshold I looked back. Once.
strings.translation: 在門口，我回頭看了一眼。就一次。

strings.text: I’ll tell them. Some day they’ll begin to listen.
strings.translation: 我會告訴他們的。總有一天，他們會開始聆聽。

strings.text: Petra was screaming, and only we could hear her
strings.translation: 佩特拉在尖叫，只有我們聽得見

strings.text: Under the turf something smooth was shining, not made by us
strings.translation: 草皮底下有個光滑的東西在發亮，不是我們做的

A fish swam over the city, and the dream only just held
strings.translation: 一條魚游過城市上空，夢境快要撐不住了

strings.text: The inspector went round the yard unhurriedly and would come to the calf any moment
strings.translation: 檢查官不慌不忙地繞著院子走，隨時都會走到小牛那裡

strings.text: The rider came closer and closer, and her foot was bare
strings.translation: 騎馬的人越來越近，而她的腳是光著的

strings.text: The lanterns shone into the fog, and the horses would not stand still
strings.translation: 提燈照進霧裡，馬兒卻站不住

strings.text: The hymn went over the field, and my father sang loudest of all
strings.translation: 聖歌飄過田野，父親唱得比誰都大聲

strings.text: She stood across the square, and we were watched
strings.translation: 她站在廣場的另一頭，而有人在看著我們

strings.text: The lantern’s light went over the field from the fence to the forest
strings.translation: 提燈的光在田野上來回掃過，從籬笆掃到森林

strings.text: My father was reading the Definitions, and no one in the kitchen moved
strings.translation: 父親在唸《定義》，廚房裡沒有人敢動

strings.text: Someone in the valley was calling me — without words
strings.translation: 山谷裡有人在呼喚我——不用言語

strings.text: The ploughman was looking our way
strings.translation: 犁田的人正往我們這邊看

strings.text: The farm lights burned far off again, and Petra was listening
strings.translation: 農場的燈火又在遠處亮起，佩特拉在聆聽

strings.text: At night the farm lights burned far apart
strings.translation: 夜裡，農場的燈火彼此相隔遙遠
